subject: Request: 45-min product impact interview for case study (recording consent)
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kelly Turner <kelly.turner@cerebrookhealth.com>
Cc: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: 45-min product impact interview for case study (recording consent)

Hi Kelly —

Hope you’re doing well. I’m coordinating a short case study interview to capture how Cerebrook Health has integrated Redwood Inference for clinical summarization and the operational impact you’ve seen. We’d love to feature Cerebrook in a short customer profile that highlights outcomes and best practices.

High-level ask: a 45-minute recorded call (we’ll share draft questions in advance). Possible dates/times I have open in my calendar next week are:
- Tue 4/27: 10:00–11:00 PDT
- Wed 4/28: 14:00–14:45 PDT
- Thu 4/29: 09:00–09:45 PDT

If none of those work, please send a few windows that do. Also: we will record the session for internal editing and marketing assets — we’ll only publish quotes with your explicit sign-off and can redact anything you’d prefer not to surface. I’ve attached a draft agenda and a short consent note for legal/records.

Participants we’d like to include (please add/remove):
- Kelly Turner — Head of Product, Cerebrook
- Aditya Rao — Product Marketing, Redwood (me)
- Aisha Rahman — Customer Success, Redwood (to capture metrics and post-call follow-ups)
- Marissa Cole — Customer Marketing, Redwood (to coordinate permissions and distribution)

Attachment: 20270422_case-interview-agenda-draft.docx (agenda + sample questions)

Thanks — no heavy prep required. If you want a targeted agenda (e.g., focus on cost savings, clinical accuracy, or developer experience) we’ll tailor it.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Product Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0199

From: Kelly Turner <kelly.turner@cerebrookhealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 11:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: 45-min product impact interview for case study (recording consent)

Hi Aditya —

Thanks for reaching out and for the clear agenda. We’d be happy to participate — this is something Kelly (me) and one of our clinical leads can join. The windows you proposed look mostly good; our preference is Wed 4/28 at 14:00 PDT. I’ll check with Dr. Ramos (clinical lead) and circle back if that changes.

A couple of quick questions before we lock:
1) Can you share the specific questions you’ll ask (even a bullet list) so we can prepare any metrics?
2) For the recording consent, do you need a signed form, or is written email confirmation sufficient for marketing/legal?

We’re okay with the recording in principle but want to ensure PHI is never captured — note that any patient-level screenshots or quotes will need to be redacted.

Kelly
Kelly Turner
Head of Product, Cerebrook Health
kelly.turner@cerebrookhealth.com
+1 (650) 555-7821

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kelly Turner <kelly.turner@cerebrookhealth.com>
Cc: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 11:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: 45-min product impact interview for case study (recording consent)

Kelly —

Appreciate the quick reply and the preference for Wed 4/28 14:00 PDT — that works for us. I’ve tentatively scheduled a 45-minute slot and included a Calendly link below for Dr. Ramos if they want to pick a different time: https://calendly.com/redwood/aditya-45min. I’ll finalize once you confirm.

Attached is a short bullet list of the questions (also pasted below) and a one-page consent text we typically use — email confirmation is fine for our records but if your legal team prefers a signed copy we can provide a DocuSign link. We will not ask for or record PHI; we’ll keep discussion at the product/outcome level and redact any specific patient identifiers.

Draft questions (what we’ll ask):
- Brief background: scope of the integration and team ownership
- Primary use cases and volumes (approx. monthly request volumes, typical prompt lengths)
- Operational impact: latency, throughput, and how that changed costs or staffing
- Quality outcomes: examples of improved workflows, developer experience anecdotes
- Metrics: any concrete numbers on time saved, error rate changes, or user adoption
- Future plans: roadmap areas where inference plays a role

Consent note (attached as cerebrook_recording-consent.txt): by replying to this email or signing the attached consent, you authorize Redwood Inference to record the interview for internal editing and marketing assets. Any quotes used in public materials will be subject to your final approval; Redwood will not publish patient-level data or PHI.

Attachments: 20270422_case-interview-agenda-draft.docx, cerebrook_recording-consent.txt

Thanks — looking forward to it. I’ll mark the calendar for Wed 4/28 14:00 PDT pending your confirmation.

Best,
Aditya
